plan: Given my value of $35, I should aim to bid just below this to maximize potential profit while still having a competitive chance to win. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid slightly below my value to avoid overpaying. A bid of $34.9 allows for a small profit margin if I win against lower bids. This bid is not dominated, as bidding above my value would not be profitable.

Given my value of $32, I aim to bid strategically to maximize profit. Bidding above $32 is dominated as it risks paying more than my value. I will bid slightly below my value to win if others undervalue their bids. A bid of $31.9 ensures I can win if others bid lower, maximizing profit by paying a lower third-highest bid. This strategy balances winning potential and profit.

Given my value of $48, I aim to bid close to my value to maximize profit while avoiding overbidding. A bid of $48 is dominated as it offers no profit if I win. I will bid slightly lower to ensure profit if I win, assuming other bids are randomly distributed. A bid of $47.9 ensures a profit margin if the third-highest bid is significantly lower.
